scenes.title: Introduction
scenes.narration: Welcome to Revelation SRS, an open source student records system for higher education. This is a quick tour of the student portal.

scenes.title: What the app is for
scenes.narration: The student portal is where you manage everything to do with your studies: your profile, your module choices, your results, and more. You sign in with the same account your institution gives you for everything else.

scenes.title: Interface orientation
scenes.narration: Once you're signed in, the dashboard gives you an at-a-glance summary: your current enrolment, key dates, and anything that needs your attention.

scenes.title: Starting the main workflow
scenes.narration: One of the most time-sensitive tasks for a student is choosing optional modules. Let's look at My Modules. Here's what Alice is currently registered for.

scenes.title: Browsing and selecting a module
scenes.narration: From here, Alice can browse every optional module available for this period, see how many credits each one carries, and add the ones she wants.

scenes.title: Confirming before saving
scenes.narration: Before anything is saved, the portal always asks you to confirm, so you can't register for a module by accident.

scenes.title: Submitting the registration
scenes.narration: Confirming sends the registration straight to Alice's record.

scenes.title: Seeing the result
scenes.narration: And back on My Modules, the new registration is right there: confirmed, dated, and ready for the module leader to see.

scenes.title: A quick look at more of the portal
scenes.narration: The portal covers a lot more than module choices. Notifications keep you posted on anything that needs attention, and your timetable is always up to date once your modules are confirmed.

scenes.title: Summary
scenes.narration: That's a quick look at the student portal: sign in, check your dashboard, manage your modules, and stay on top of everything else in one place.
